mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Physical->no family (crosswalk §1 physical rule); the blades deal physical hit-damage, element-neutral, identity via geometry+propagation. The IDENTITY MISS: the lingering-blade field is a FIELD RESOURCE you plant (Bladefall) then consume (Blade Blast) — econ_raw=field-resource-consume. Engine placed entities (placed_lane/totem) are autonomous colliders, not a detonation-queue whose every member is spent by a second skill. Mapped as multi_projectile-seed -> ring-detonation-cascade (GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade), which captures the plant-then-explode feel but LOSES 'the blade field is a spendable ammunition pool.' A BF/BB player would notice their two skills are no longer coupled by a shared consumable field-substrate — the blade-count-as-detonation-budget is what made the combo sing. Field-resource-consume docketed (shared family with animate-weapon's ground-item-as-ammo, batch-01). The 30-detonations/s empty-the-queue cadence is a magnitude the ring+propagation approximates. Profane Bloom cursed-death chaining routes as the GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade on-kill reading.
